intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} both sit in {{cityA}}, and this page compares their recorded {{course}} fees, placements, admission routes and campus setting, using our database and official pages we opened in {{year}}.
Indore Institute of Management and Research vs PIMR Indore is not a single winner. Compare fees, admission tests and the MBA / PGDM classroom each campus offers.

sections.heading: Indore Institute of Management and Research vs PIMR Indore for MBA / PGDM: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose Indore Institute of Management and Research if you want a 2023 flagship package record of ₹4 LPA, and a recorded fee of ₹63,000, in a private MBA / PGDM setting at Indore.
Choose PIMR Indore if you want a recorded fee of ₹40,000, and an admission route through CMAT, in a private MBA / PGDM setting at Indore.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: On this page we quote a programme total when we hold a Total Fees record, and we skip short, executive or certificate rows when the picker can tell them apart. Always match the fee to the exact programme you will join.

Our records show ₹63,000 as a tuition figure for MBA Production & Operations Management at Indore Institute of Management and Research. Treat this as a recorded tuition figure, not a confirmed two-year total, unless the official notice says otherwise.
Our records show ₹40,000 as a tuition figure for MBA at PIMR Indore. Treat this as a recorded tuition figure, not a confirmed two-year total, unless the official notice says otherwise.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Indore Institute of Management and Research's latest recorded flagship year here is 2023, with an average of ₹4 LPA and a highest package of ₹12 LPA on MBA Production & Operations Management. These are historical batch figures, not a salary promise.
We do not hold a 2020-or-later flagship placement year for PIMR Indore here, so do not treat older or unofficial packages as current.
If you are comparing offers, use the latest official placement report from each institute and match the programme name, not an executive or certificate batch.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Indore Institute of Management and Research is listed on our records with CMAT as an admission route for this MBA / PGDM comparison. Confirm the current brochure for cut-offs, interviews and any extra institute test.
PIMR Indore is listed on our records with CMAT as an admission route for this MBA / PGDM comparison. Confirm the current brochure for cut-offs, interviews and any extra institute test.
Eligibility wording can change by cycle. Use the current official admission brochure rather than last year's cut-off stories.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in {{cityA}}, Madhya Pradesh. If you want to stay in this city, the choice is less about relocation and more about the classroom, fees and the admission route.
Visit both campuses if you can, or at least read each official hostel and location note, before you treat travel time or hostel cost as a given.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: If you want a documented flagship placement year, Indore Institute of Management and Research is the clearer record here, because PIMR Indore has no 2020-or-later flagship package on this page.

Use official fee notices rather than our raw minimums, then decide whether PIMR Indore's recorded ₹40,000 or Indore Institute of Management and Research's ₹63,000 fits your budget for this MBA / PGDM.
If fees are the only filter, do not use the lowest number in our raw rows. Check each official fee notice for the exact programme and batch you will join.

faqs.question: Which is better in 2026, Indore Institute of Management and Research or PIMR Indore?
faqs.answer: It depends on the programme you want. Indore Institute of Management and Research and PIMR Indore differ in more than one way: the useful differences are fees, the admission test and the kind of MBA / PGDM classroom each campus offers.

faqs.question: What are the recorded fees for Indore Institute of Management and Research vs PIMR Indore?
faqs.answer: our records list ₹63,000 for Indore Institute of Management and Research on MBA Production & Operations Management; our records list ₹40,000 for PIMR Indore on MBA. Confirm both official notices before you decide.

faqs.question: How do placements compare for Indore Institute of Management and Research and PIMR Indore?
faqs.answer: Indore Institute of Management and Research's latest recorded flagship year here is 2023, with an average of ₹4 LPA and a highest package of ₹12 LPA on MBA Production & Operations Management. These are historical batch figures, not a salary promise.

faqs.question: Which entrance exams do Indore Institute of Management and Research and PIMR Indore accept?
faqs.answer: Our records list CMAT for Indore Institute of Management and Research, and CMAT for PIMR Indore. Always confirm the current admission brochure, because tests and cut-offs change by year.

faqs.question: Are Indore Institute of Management and Research and PIMR Indore in the same city?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both are in Indore, Madhya Pradesh. The move is about the programme, fees and tests, not a change of city.

faqs.question: Should I treat this comparison as a final admission decision?
faqs.answer: No. Fees, eligibility and placements change by year and by programme. Verify the current official fee notice, admission brochure and placement report of each institute before you apply.
